Neath the Puke Tree
is an
EP
by
Bill Callahan
(also known as Smog).
[
4
]
[
5
]
It was released on
Drag City
in 2000.
[
6
]
Recorded by Brent "Sloth" Puncheon and Leah Baker, it includes remakes of previous work ("I Was a Stranger" from
Red Apple Falls
and "A Jar of Sand" from
Sewn to the Sky
) as well as three new songs.
Charlie Gansa played guitar on the record; "Sloth" and
Jim White
played drums. White would return to play drums on
Supper
and
A River Ain't Too Much to Love
.
